boardChanged: The board changed. Reload it and try again.
managedInJira: This board is managed in Jira. Make this change there.
reconnectJira: Reconnect Jira in Settings › Connectors to make changes.
firstSync: Wait for the first sync with Jira to finish.
jiraDisconnected: Jira is disconnected. Reconnect it in Settings › Connectors to keep this board in sync.
connectJiraFirst: Connect Jira in Settings › Connectors first.
jiraBoardUnavailable: That Jira board isn’t available to your Jira account.
jiraBoardSynced: This Jira board is already synced.
notJiraBoard: Only boards synced with Jira can be synced.
jiraBoardWorkspaceTasks: Jira boards show Jira issues only. Pick a board kept in the app.
workspaceTaskCopy: Workspace tasks can’t be duplicated here. Add a task in the workspace instead.
workspaceTaskDelete: Workspace tasks leave the board when they’re done or reassigned in the workspace.
boardNameTooLong: That name is too long. Use a shorter one.
invalidRequest: Something in the request isn’t right. Reload the page and try again.
